requirements.quote:
When an ack-eliciting packet is transmitted, the sender schedules a
   timer for the PTO period as follows:
requirements.condition: When an ack-eliciting packet is transmitted and no more specific rule in this section prevents PTO timer arming
requirements.required_behavior: The sender schedules a timer for the PTO period.
requirements.why_checkable: A transmission trace can verify that an eligible ack-eliciting packet causes the sender to arm a PTO timer.

requirements.required_behavior: Compute PTO as smoothed_rtt plus the greater of four times rttvar and kGranularity, plus max_ack_delay.
requirements.why_checkable: Given the four input values, a test can compare the implementation's PTO period with the stated formula.

requirements.quote:
When the PTO is armed for Initial or Handshake packet number spaces,
   the max_ack_delay in the PTO period computation is set to 0
requirements.condition: When the PTO is armed for the Initial packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Use 0 for max_ack_delay in the PTO period computation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a nonzero max_ack_delay in this computation.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can arm an Initial-space PTO with a nonzero configured peer delay and inspect the value used in the computation.

requirements.quote:
When the PTO is armed for Initial or Handshake packet number spaces,
   the max_ack_delay in the PTO period computation is set to 0
requirements.condition: When the PTO is armed for the Handshake packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Use 0 for max_ack_delay in the PTO period computation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a nonzero max_ack_delay in this computation.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can arm a Handshake-space PTO with a nonzero configured peer delay and inspect the value used in the computation.

requirements.quote:
The PTO period MUST be at least kGranularity to avoid the timer
   expiring immediately.
requirements.condition: Whenever a PTO period is computed
requirements.required_behavior: Clamp or otherwise choose the PTO period so that it is at least kGranularity.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Produce a PTO period less than kGranularity.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary inputs can verify that every computed PTO period is greater than or equal to kGranularity.

requirements.quote:
When ack-eliciting packets in multiple packet number spaces are in
   flight, the timer MUST be set to the earlier value of the Initial and
   Handshake packet number spaces.
requirements.condition: When ack-eliciting packets in multiple packet number spaces are in flight
requirements.required_behavior: Set the timer to the earlier of the Initial-space and Handshake-space timer values.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Set the timer to a later candidate value.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish distinct Initial and Handshake deadlines and inspect which deadline is armed.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST NOT set its PTO timer for the Application Data
   packet number space until the handshake is confirmed.
requirements.required_behavior: Leave the PTO timer for the Application Data packet number space unset.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Set a PTO timer for the Application Data packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: The endpoint's timer state can be inspected before and after handshake confirmation.

requirements.quote:
A sender SHOULD restart its PTO timer every time an ack-eliciting
   packet is sent
requirements.condition: Every time the sender sends an ack-eliciting packet
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the armed timer before and after each ack-eliciting transmission.

requirements.quote:
A sender SHOULD restart its PTO timer every time an ack-eliciting
   packet is sent or acknowledged
requirements.condition: Every time one of the sender's ack-eliciting packets is acknowledged
requirements.why_checkable: A test can acknowledge an ack-eliciting packet and observe whether the timer is restarted from the updated state.

requirements.quote:
A sender SHOULD restart its PTO timer every time an ack-eliciting
   packet is sent or acknowledged, or when Initial or Handshake keys are
   discarded
requirements.why_checkable: A test can trigger Initial-key discard and observe whether the PTO timer is restarted for the remaining packet number spaces.

requirements.quote:
A sender SHOULD restart its PTO timer every time an ack-eliciting
   packet is sent or acknowledged, or when Initial or Handshake keys are
   discarded
requirements.why_checkable: A test can trigger Handshake-key discard and observe whether the PTO timer is restarted for the remaining packet number spaces.

requirements.quote:
When a PTO timer expires, the PTO backoff MUST be increased,
   resulting in the PTO period being set to twice its current value.
requirements.required_behavior: Increase the PTO backoff so that the PTO period becomes twice its current value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave the backoff unchanged or compute a next PTO period other than twice the current value.
requirements.why_checkable: Consecutive expiry events can verify both the backoff transition and exact doubling of the PTO period.

requirements.quote:
The PTO backoff factor is reset when an acknowledgment is received,
   except in the following case.
requirements.condition: When an acknowledgment is received and the stated client address-validation exception does not apply
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retain the increased PTO backoff factor.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can raise the backoff, deliver an acknowledgment outside the exception, and inspect the resulting factor.

requirements.quote:
a client does not reset
   the PTO backoff factor on receiving acknowledgments in Initial
   packets.
requirements.condition: When a client receives an acknowledgment in an Initial packet
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve the current PTO backoff factor.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reset the PTO backoff factor because of that acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: A client test can establish a non-default backoff, process an Initial acknowledgment, and verify that the factor is unchanged.

requirements.quote:
Even when there are ack-
   eliciting packets in flight in multiple packet number spaces, the
   exponential increase in PTO occurs across all spaces
requirements.condition: When PTO backoff increases while ack-eliciting packets are in flight in multiple packet number spaces
requirements.required_behavior: Apply the exponential PTO increase across all packet number spaces.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Increase PTO only in the packet number space whose timer expired.
requirements.why_checkable: A multi-space test can expire one PTO and compare the post-expiry PTO periods for every active space.

requirements.quote:
The total length of time over which consecutive PTOs expire is
   limited by the idle timeout.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit their total expiration interval by the idle timeout.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Continue consecutive PTO expiration beyond the idle timeout.
requirements.why_checkable: A simulated clock can verify that PTO expiry processing does not continue past the configured idle-timeout boundary.

requirements.quote:
The PTO timer MUST NOT be set if a timer is set for time threshold
   loss detection
requirements.condition: When a timer is already set for time-threshold loss detection
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Set the PTO timer concurrently with the time-threshold loss-detection timer.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer state can be inspected after arming time-threshold loss detection to ensure no PTO timer is also armed.
